# workshop-tools

Where things live on the garage shelving, roughly organized by project rather than by tool type.

- Top shelf: bike stand, truing stand, spoke wrenches, the dish gauge
- Middle shelf: networking gear waiting to go into the rack — patch cables, the spare UniFi switch
- Bottom shelf: overflow from the [[gear-list]], mostly stuff without a permanent home yet

Meant to build a proper pegboard wall at some point instead of shelving everything, but that project
keeps losing to whatever's more urgent that weekend.
